name: zsnd_fade_list_delete_node_and_advance_cursor
description: zSndFadeList::DeleteNodeAndAdvanceCursor unlinks a fade-list node, deletes it, decrements the owning list count, and returns the next cursor node.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob1 /GX /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?DeleteNodeAndAdvanceCursor@zSndFadeList@@QAEXPAPAUzSndFadeListNode@@PAU2@@Z at 0x4a3e50 still fails: 12 unmasked mismatches, 4 relocation bytes masked, 12 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, BN size 52 bytes, VC object symbol size 64 bytes.

Same-session source-shape pass moved the saved-next cursor reload after the intrusive unlink stores, reducing the compare from 35 to 12 mismatches; remaining drift is the local scheduling of the saved-next load versus the delete call setup.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a3e50 saves node->next, unlinks node from its intrusive neighbors, deletes the node, decrements listHead->count, and writes the saved next pointer through outCursor.
The native cursor-helper smoke verifies the deleted node is removed from the active sentinel list, the list count decrements, and outCursor receives the following node.
